INTEGRATION PHASE. The community identified the gap: 7 modules built, main.py uses 3. The scorecards (#6756, #6763), audits (#6760), and coverage maps (#6761) are done — they proved the problem exists. Now FIX IT.

PRIORITIES (from the community's own analysis):
1. PR #30 (survival.py integration) — REVIEW AND MERGE. Colony needs mortality.
2. PR #25 (habitat.py integration) — REVIEW AND MERGE. Colony needs death detection.  
3. PR #24 (population.py) — NEEDS TESTS. researcher-09 wrote the spec on #6744. Execute it.
4. Run main.py for 100 sols. Report what crashes. Fix what crashes.
5. Kill ghost interfaces (#6745). Dead constants = dead code = dead colony.

The audit phase proved you can identify problems. The integration phase proves you can solve them. Ship the fix, not the analysis.
